news.title: Netflix Is 48% Below Its High While Guiding to Record Revenue of $51.1 Billion, Up 13%, for 2026
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix hit a new 52-week low this week, 48% below its high a year ago, while guiding 2026 revenue to a record $51. 1 billion.
news.title_zh: Netflix 低於其高點 48%，同時指引創紀錄收入 $51.1 Billion，增長 13%，針對 2026
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Netflix 本週觸及新的 52 週低點，較一年前高點低 48%，同時指引 2026 收入達創紀錄的 $51。1 billion.

news.title: Nick Khan on Making WWE a Global Media Power
news.summary: In this episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly talk with WWE president Nick Khan at Bloomberg’s Screentime conference about his deals with Netflix and ESPN. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Nick Khan 談打造 WWE 成為全球媒體強權
news.summary_zh: 在《The Deal》這一集中，Alex Rodriguez 和 Jason Kelly 在彭博 Screentime 大會上與 WWE 總裁 Nick Khan 對談，討論他與 Netflix 和 ESPN 的交易。（來源：彭博）

news.title: Skydance Skips FIFA World Cup Bid as Netflix, Fox Eye $4 Billion Deal
news.summary: Skydance Corp. is opting out of bidding for the US media rights for the next FIFA Men’s World Cup tournaments in what could be one of the costliest and competitive auctions in the global soccer event’s history, according to people familiar with the matter.
news.title_zh: Skydance 放棄 FIFA 世界盃標案，Netflix、Fox 覬覦 $4 Billion 交易
news.summary_zh: 據知情人士透露，Skydance Corp. 選擇退出下屆 FIFA 男子世界盃美國媒體版權的競標，這可能成為全球足球賽事歷史上最昂貴且競爭最激烈的拍賣之一。

news.title: Josh Brown Says Netflix Trades at 16 Times Next Year’s Earnings After a 50% Drop. Is It a Buy?
news.summary: Josh Brown once called Netflix his biggest mistake of the year, then watched the stock sink even further. Now he sees a bargain hiding in the wreckage, but the bear case has real teeth, and one upcoming report could settle the debate.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 交易價為 16 Times 倍明年盈利，此前下跌 50%。是否值得買入？
news.summary_zh: Josh Brown 曾稱 Netflix 為他年度最大錯誤，隨後目睹股價進一步下挫。如今他看見殘局中藏著便宜貨，但空頭論點確有威力，即將到來的一份報告可能終結辯論。

news.title: Netflix Stock Just Closed Below $60 for the First Time Since August 2024. I'd Buy It Now.
news.summary: The streaming giant's shares have hit the price I said I'd pay. Is there a good reason to wait longer?
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價剛收盤跌破 $60，為自 August 2024 以來首次。我現在會買入。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭的股價已觸及我說會買入的價格。還有好的理由再等待嗎？

news.title: Inside Netflix’s Fight to Keep the Streaming Crown
news.summary: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world. In conversations with Co-CEO Ted Sarandos and Hollywood stars Ben Affleck and Lily Collins, Chang probes the company's global strategy, AI ambitions and executive shakeups. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 深入 Netflix 為保住串流霸主地位而戰
news.summary_zh: Emily Chang 前往巴黎、首爾和洛杉磯，探索 Netflix 在娛樂界的下一章。在與聯席執行長 Ted Sarandos 以及好萊塢巨星 Ben Affleck 和 Lily Collins 的對話中，Chang 探究該公司的全球策略、AI 野心和高層變動。(來源: Bloomberg)

news.title: Netflix Just Hit a 52-Week Low. Where’s the Bottom?
news.summary: Netflix has shed nearly half its value from the peak, and ad cuts and a massive Warner Bros. bet are fueling the fear. Yet record buybacks and fat margins tell a different story, so which signal should investors trust?
news.title_zh: Netflix 剛觸及 52 週低點。底在哪裡？
news.summary_zh: Netflix 從高點已蒸發近半價值，廣告削減和大規模押注 Warner Bros. 正加劇恐慌。然而創紀錄回購和豐厚利潤率卻講述不同故事，投資人該信哪個訊號？

news.title: Disney Weighs a Free Disney+ Tier. Netflix’s $8.99 Ad Plan Has a Big Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDisney beat estimates with $25. 95 billion of fiscal fourth-quarter revenue and said again that it is exploring a free, ad-supported version of Disney+.
news.title_zh: Disney 權衡免費 Disney+ 方案。Netflix 的 $8.99 廣告方案有大問題
news.summary_zh: 重點Disney 擊敗預估，達 $25。95 billion 財年第四季營收，並再次表示正探索免費、廣告支持版 Disney+。

news.title: Why Did ASTS, NFLX, RCAT Stocks Plunge To 52-Week Lows Today?
news.summary: Operational challenges and setbacks weighed on investor confidence across space, streaming and defense stocks.
news.title_zh: 為何 ASTS、NFLX、RCAT 股價今日暴跌至 52 週低點？
news.summary_zh: 營運挑戰和挫折拖累太空、串流和防禦類股的投資人信心。

news.title: Netflix Stock Hasn't Been This Cheap in Over 2 Years. Is Now the Time to Buy?
news.summary: The streaming stock has crashed 45% in the past 12 months, despite posting strong numbers.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價已超過 2 年未曾這麼便宜。現在是買入時機嗎？
news.summary_zh: 這檔串流媒體股票在過去 12 個月暴跌 45%，儘管財報表現強勁。

news.title: Cathie Wood and 16 Other Big Funds Bought Netflix Last Quarter, While 20 Sold. Who’s Right?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 456 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 17 bought Netflix, Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest among them, and 20 sold, including George Soros’ fund. The biggest moves came from less famous firms: Harris Associates added about $556 million of Netflix stock at quarter-end prices, while Sands Capital sold about $184 million.
news.title_zh: Cathie Wood 和 16 家其他大型基金上季買入 Netflix，而 20 則賣出。誰是對的？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：在已為第三季提交 13F 文件的 456 家大型基金中，17 買入 Netflix，Cathie Wood 的 ARK Invest 即在其中，而 20 則賣出，包括 George Soros 的基金。最大的動作來自較不知名的公司：Harris Associates 在季末價格買入約 $556 million 的 Netflix 股票，而 Sands Capital 則賣出約 $184 million。

news.title: Why Netflix Stock Is At A One-Year Low
news.summary: Our Nov 16 piece, Can Netflix Stock Fall 50%, found that Netflix (NFLX) has fallen 50% or more from high to low in three of the 15 market shocks it has traded through. That is the crash question. The next question is the one owners live with every day: what is the real risk now, with no shock in sight.
news.title_zh: 為何 Netflix 股價處於一年低點
news.summary_zh: 我們的 Nov 16 文章《Netflix 股價會下跌 50% 嗎？》發現，Netflix (NFLX) 在其交易經歷的 15 次市場衝擊中，有三次從高點到低點下跌了 50% 或更多。這就是崩盤問題。下一個問題是持有者每天都要面對的：在沒有衝擊的情況下，現在的真實風險是什麼。

news.title: Fed Hawks Turn Up Heat As Inflation Fears Grow
news.summary: The Treasury market has been pricing in higher odds for a series of rate hikes for months.
news.title_zh: 聯準會鷹派加碼施壓，通膨恐懼升溫
news.summary_zh: 公債市場數月來已將連續加息的機率大幅提高。

news.title: The AI Selloff May Be Over. Here Are 3 Reasons Why
news.summary: Hawkish Fed repricing, surging bond yields and dollar strength have pressured AI; stabilizing yields and a dollar peak could support a rebound.
news.title_zh: AI 拋售潮可能已結束。以下為 3 項原因
news.summary_zh: 聯準會鷹派重新定價、債券殖利率飆升與美元走強打壓 AI；殖利率企穩與美元見頂可能支撐反彈。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: Charting The Year Ahead: Investment Ideas For 2027
news.summary: As AI concentration reshapes markets, investors can find diversifying strategies to broaden opportunities while still seeking attractive returns.
news.title_zh: 展望來年：2027 投資構想
news.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 集中度重塑市場，投資人可尋找多元化策略擴大機會，同時仍追求吸引人報酬。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正悄悄縮減其會議行程，長期公債已有所反應。隨著十二月即將加息，較少的決策日可能使每個驚喜對債券持有者的衝擊更大。債券市場的哪個角落受損最重？

news.title: The U.S. Just Ran Its Biggest October Deficit Ever: $404 Billion
news.summary: A record October gap has a calendar quirk hiding the real story, and bond investors are already reacting. Why do long-dated Treasury funds feel the pain first, and what would prove the bearish case wrong by December?
news.title_zh: 美國剛錄得有史以來最大的十月赤字：$404 Billion
news.summary_zh: 創紀錄的十月缺口因行曆怪癖而掩蓋了真實故事，債券投資者已有反應。為何長期公債基金首當其衝感受痛苦，到十二月什麼情況能證明看空論點錯誤？

news.title: How Large Does Your Portfolio Need to Be to Generate $9,400 a Month?
news.summary: Six income holdings, one monthly paycheck target, and a stretch of the portfolio that could vanish in a merger. See which pick carries the shakiest check and which one quietly raises its payout every year.
news.title_zh: 您的投資組合需要多大才能每月產生 $9,400？
news.summary_zh: 六檔收益型持倉、一個月度薪資目標，以及一段可能因合併而消失的投資組合部分。看看哪一檔的支票最不穩固，哪一檔每年悄悄增加派息。

news.title: The Treasury Secretary Is Now Living on a Military Base After Iranian Threats
news.summary: Markets barely flinched when news broke that a cabinet secretary had moved onto a military base. Yet the quiet in oil and long bonds may hide a bigger risk for anyone holding USO or TLT, and a few scheduled events could expose it.
news.title_zh: 財政部長在伊朗威脅後現居住於軍事基地
news.summary_zh: 當內閣部長遷入軍事基地的消息傳出時，市場幾乎未受驚動。然而，原油與長期債券的平靜可能掩蓋著持有 USO 或 TLT 者的更大風險，且幾項既定事件可能揭露該風險。

news.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Improved AMD’s Best Chip Design by Up to 14%
news.summary: OpenAI's models rewrote the code behind AMD's chips, and AMD shareholders are cheering. But the partner making the claim stands to profit if AMD looks strong, and one overlooked winner may hold the lasting edge.
news.title_zh: OpenAI 表示其 AI 將 AMD 最佳晶片設計提升高達 14%
news.summary_zh: OpenAI 的模型重寫了 AMD 晶片背後的代碼，AMD 股東歡呼。但提出該主張的合作夥伴若 AMD 表現強勢將獲利，且一位被忽視的贏家可能掌握長期優勢。

news.title: Why Did David Tepper Exit AMD and Open a $172M Oracle Position? Here’s What May Have Driven the Shift
news.summary: One AI giant is up nearly 150% this year, the other is down roughly 40%, and Appaloosa picked the loser. Tepper's latest 13F hints at a contrarian bet, but the cash burn behind it is hard to ignore.
news.title_zh: 為何 David Tepper 離場 AMD 並建立 $172M Oracle 部位？這可能是轉變的原因
news.summary_zh: 一家 AI 巨頭今年上漲近 150%，另一家則下跌約 40%，Appaloosa 選了輸家。Tepper 最新的 13F 暗示反向押注，但其背後的現金燃燒難以忽視。

news.title: Why Is AMD Stock Rising Overnight?
news.summary: OpenAI said its models boosted AMD GPU efficiency, while ‘GTA VI’ maker Rockstar Games said it used AMD’s tech for image scaling in the game.
news.title_zh: 為何 AMD 股價隔夜上漲？
news.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示其模型提升了 AMD GPU 效能，而《GTA VI》開發商 Rockstar Games 稱在遊戲中使用 AMD 技術進行影像縮放。

news.title: Broadcom Already Eclipsed AMD as The 2nd Biggest Chip Maker, But The Market Won’t Recognize That Truth Until 2027
news.summary: AMD's stock is soaring while its bigger rival barely moves, and both just posted record AI quarters for the same customers. One difference in how they make money could decide which chip maker the market finally crowns by 2027.
news.title_zh: Broadcom 已超越 AMD 成為第 2 大晶片製造商，但市場要到 2027 才會認清這事實
news.summary_zh: AMD 股價飆漲而其更大競爭對手幾乎不動，雙方剛剛都為相同客戶交出創紀錄 AI 季度。獲利模式一項差異可能決定市場最終在 2027 加冕哪家晶片製造商。

news.title: Is Nvidia's Margin Lead Over AMD Shrinking?
news.summary: Today's big story: Anthropic IPO: Priced For 2031, Or 2036.
news.title_zh: 英偉達對AMD的毛利優勢是否縮水？
news.summary_zh: 今日重磅消息：Anthropic IPO：定價為 2031，或 2036。

news.title: Nvidia’s CEO Calls Customer Shifts “Just Not True.” Broadcom and AMD’s Frontier Deal Share Says Otherwise
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said the idea that its customers are shifting is “just not true,” after a $115. 8 billion quarter.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 執行長稱客戶轉移說「並非事實」。Broadcom 與 AMD 的 Frontier 交易股價另有說法
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Nvidia 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 表示，其客戶正在轉移的說法「並非事實」，這是在一個 $115 之後。8 billion 季度。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMontanova Capital, which manages $7. 87 billion, had sold all of its Advanced Micro Devices, Arcus Biosciences and Ferguson Enterprises shares by Sept.
news.title_zh: 一家 $7.9 Billion 基金拋售這些 3 股票

news.title: Nvidia Is Well Off Its Highs, but Our Model Still Sees 29% Upside
news.summary: Nvidia just posted another record quarter, yet its stock sits near a 52-week low after Jensen Huang abruptly stepped down. One valuation gap against AMD and Broadcom explains why our model thinks the market is getting this wrong.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 股價遠離高點，但我們模型仍看好 29% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 剛公布另一創紀錄季度，但股價徘徊在 52 週低點附近，因黃仁勳突然辭職。相對 AMD 和 Broadcom 的一項估值差距，解釋為何我們模型認為市場判斷錯誤。

news.title: Super Micro Computer’s 40% 3 Month Downturn: A Great Entry Point Says This Wall Street Pro Who Predicts 165% Returns
news.summary: Super Micro posted record growth, yet a federal probe and thin margins have sent the stock tumbling while Dell and HPE hold up better. One Raymond James analyst sees a bargain, but most of Wall Street is staying put, and one unresolved question may decide who is right.
news.title_zh: Super Micro Computer 的 40% 3 月下跌：這位預測 165% 回報的華爾街專業人士稱是絕佳進場點
news.summary_zh: Super Micro 發布創紀錄增長，但聯邦調查和薄利潤率導致股價暴跌，而 Dell 和 HPE 表現較好。一位 Raymond James 分析師認為這是便宜貨，但大多數華爾街人士選擇觀望，一個未解決的問題可能決定誰是對的。

news.title: Why Is Advanced Micro Devices Stock Rising Today?
news.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) shares gained 2. 7% in premarket trading, supported by stronger-than-expected earnings from rival Nvidia, the completion of a major artificial intelligence acquisition and continued analyst optimism about AMD’s data centre business.
news.title_zh: 超微電腦股價今日為何上漲？
news.summary_zh: 超微電腦 (NASDAQ:AMD) 股價在盤前交易上漲 2。7%，受惠於競爭對手輝達盈利優於預期、完成大型人工智慧收購案，以及分析師持續看好 AMD 資料中心業務。

news.title: Do You Even Have An AMD Tax Loss?
news.summary: Yes, but only if you bought AMD after late May. A share bought at the start of 2026 is up 135.1%. That is a gain, not a loss. AMD closed at $503.41 on Tuesday, Nov 17. It closed above that price on 81 of the 221 trading days of 2026. All of those days fell between May 26 and Nov 16. Only a share bought at one of those closes shows a loss now.
news.title_zh: 你真的有 AMD 稅務虧損嗎？
news.summary_zh: 有，但前提是你在五月下旬後買入 AMD。在 2026 開始時買入的股票上漲了 135.1%。這是獲利，不是虧損。AMD 在週二收於 $503.41，Nov 17。在 2026 的 221 個交易日中，有 81 天收盤價高於該價格。所有這些交易日都落在 May 26 和 Nov 16 之間。只有在這些收盤價之一買入的股票現在才顯示虧損。

news.title: Shots Fired: Musk Says SpaceX Assumes “Zero Sales to OpenAI.” AMD Can’t Say the Same

news.title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
news.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.
news.title_zh: Marvell 和 Intel 腰斬：多久才能回升？
news.summary_zh: 自六月以來，Marvell 和 Intel 都已損失超過一半價值。在 Nov 17 星期二收盤時，Marvell 報 $148.74。這比其在 June 4 的高點收盤價 $316.43 低 53.0%。Intel 收於 $55.17，比其 June 22 高點低 60.9%。關於晶片股拋售的大多數論調要么是逢低買入的呼籲，要么是 AI 交易結束的警告。本文探討一個更窄的問題：當晶片股腰斬時，有多大機率能回到高點，以及需要多久時間。

news.title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
news.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.

news.title: Nvidia’s Annual GPU Upgrades Are Changing the HBM Investment Outlook
news.summary: Nvidia's newest chip delivers far more performance, yet the memory inside it barely changes. For Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix, that quiet shift could rewrite what really drives AI memory profits, and investors who assume otherwise may be misreading the cycle.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 每年 GPU 升級正改變 HBM 投資展望
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 最新晶片提供大幅更高效能,但內部記憶體幾乎未變。對 Micron、Samsung 和 SK hynix 而言,這安靜的轉變可能重寫真正驅動 AI 記憶體獲利的因素,假設相反的投資人可能誤判週期。

news.title: Not Micron, Not Sandisk. This Is My Top Memory Stock for 2027.
news.summary: SK Hynix is bigger than Micron and Sandisk in the DRAM and NAND flash markets, which is why it has the potential to outperform them next year.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia’s supply commitments rose to $390 billion from $279 billion in its fiscal third quarter, mostly for memory it’s buying over several years. SK hynix gets more of Nvidia’s memory spending than any other supplier, and Nvidia is already its biggest customer.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Nvidia 供應承諾在其財務第三季度增至 $390 billion 從 $279 billion，多為其未來數年採購的記憶體。SK Hynix 獲得 Nvidia 記憶體支出中最大比例，且 Nvidia 已是其最大客戶。

Most of the selling followed news from other companies, including the CEO’s resignation at Nvidia, SK hynix’s biggest customer, while SK hynix posted the best quarter in its history.

news.title: SK Hynix Is Down 16% in a Month. What Will It Take to Get SKHY Stock Back to $150?
news.summary: SK Hynix is sliding with the rest of the memory group, yet it is falling the least among its peers. A price-fixing lawsuit, a looming NVIDIA earnings report, and China's rise all stand between the stock and a comeback.
